sections.title: Rapid Sequence Induction (RSI)
sections.focus: Every induction and paralytic dose and its maximum; pre-oxygenation and pre-intubation optimisation thresholds; the sequence and wait intervals; attempt limits and when to stop an attempt; confirmation of placement; post-intubation management; pediatric differences.

sections.title: RSI Checklist
sections.focus: The checklist itself (PDF p292 is an image — read it visually; OCR backs the validator): each checklist line, HEAVEN criteria, pre-oxygenation set-up, the atropine age cut-off, the drug-dose card values, ETT depth formulas. Ask what the checklist requires at each step.
